note: Semantics from source comparisons in promptbuilder/toolbuilder/serializer/parser_guard/compaction. Not inferred from env names. Unexplained consumed names block preflight. Do not forward arbitrary env or realcontext.

RAKAZO_ASSIST_PROMPT.source: executor.ts assistOperatingRules / assistSplitInstructions / longWorkProgressGuidance / history-retrieval clause
RAKAZO_ASSIST_PROMPT.semantics: off when === "0"; otherwise on (including unset). Boolean 0/1 switch, not prompt text.

RAKAZO_ASSIST_STABLE_PREFIX.semantics: off when === "0" (skip turn_context split); otherwise on. Boolean 0/1 switch, not prefix text.

RAKAZO_ASSIST_DEFAULT_DISABLED_TOOLS.semantics: comma-separated builtin tool names merged into the bot disabled list.

RAKAZO_ASSIST_SCHEDULE_GUARD.omitReason: schedule path; not used by the three chat/completions serializer cases

RAKAZO_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.source: executor.ts schedule timezone; ctxmem.ts todayIn fallback

RAKAZO_ALWAYS_OVERRIDE.omitReason: approval override path; not the three serializer cases

RAKAZO_APPROVAL_RACE_FIX.semantics: on unless trim() === "0". Approval race path.
RAKAZO_APPROVAL_RACE_FIX.omitReason: approval path; not the three serializer cases

RAKAZO_DEDUPE_FINAL_POSTS.omitReason: final-post dedupe; not the three serializer cases

RAKAZO_ASSIST_HARNESS.source: executor.ts and pi-runtime.ts === "0" disables assist harness
RAKAZO_ASSIST_HARNESS.semantics: off when === "0"; otherwise on. Boolean 0/1 switch.

RAKAZO_COORD_SCALE.source: builtin-tools.ts Number(RAKAZO_COORD_SCALE ?? "") IIFE at module load
RAKAZO_COORD_SCALE.semantics: positive number rewrites computer_act coordinate notes in tool JSON; unset/0 leaves pixel coords.

RAKAZO_BOT_ASK_WAIT.source: builtin-tools.ts truthy && !== "0" appends wait_for_reply text; botdir.ts botdirSwitch
RAKAZO_BOT_ASK_WAIT.semantics: on when set, non-empty, and not "0".

RAKAZO_BOT_DIRECTORY_CARDS.source: botdir.ts botdirSwitch: set, non-empty, not "0", not "false"

RAKAZO_OPENAI_COMPAT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARG.source: pi-openai-compatible-provider.ts withChatTemplateKwargs JSON.parse merge into body.chat_template_kwargs; fast-thinking.ts applyThinkingPolicy may delete medium_effort only when thinking is off
RAKAZO_OPENAI_COMPAT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARG.semantics: JSON object. Observed keys enable_thinking and medium_effort, both boolean. Unknown keys are unexplained affected fields.

RAKAZO_FAST_COMPUTER_STEPS.semantics: on when === "1"; otherwise off. When on and last step is computer/browser tool results, sets enable_thinking=false and deletes medium_effort.

RAKAZO_THINKING_BUDGET.source: fast-thinking.ts applyThinkingBudget /^[1-9][0-9]{0,5}$/ sets top-level body.thinking_budget, never kwargs
RAKAZO_THINKING_BUDGET.semantics: positive int 1..999999. Top-level HTTP field, not a chat_template_kwargs key.

RAKAZO_THINKING_BUDGET_MODELS.source: fast-thinking.ts comma-separated exact model id match

RAKAZO_MODEL_STREAM_TIMEOUT_MS.source: pi-runtime-limits.ts Number, min 10000 else 120000, IIFE at module load

RAKAZO_MODEL_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.source: pi-runtime-limits.ts Number, min 10000 else 180000, IIFE at module load

PI_DEFAULT_MODEL.omitReason: capture does not forward live PI_DEFAULT_MODEL; model id is qwen3.8-flash-next from space preference via resolveModel

PI_DEFAULT_PROVIDER.omitReason: capture injects a synthetic stub model; do not forward live provider names

RAKAZO_CTXMEM.source: ctxmem.ts === "1"; executor.ts ctxmemEnabled/ctxmemFactsEnabled for rolling summary and set_fact tools

RAKAZO_CTXMEM_FACTS.semantics: off when === "0" while ctxmem is on; otherwise on if ctxmem is on.

RAKAZO_SUBAGENT_STEERING.semantics: on when 1/true/yes; unset is off. Nested subagent user-message injection.
RAKAZO_SUBAGENT_STEERING.omitReason: subagent nested-run steering; the three serializer cases and parser-guard stub do not spawn a subagent

RAKAZO_GUARD_FINAL_SUMMARY.source: pi-runtime.ts runtidyGuardSummaryEnabled: set, non-empty, not "0", not "false"
RAKAZO_GUARD_FINAL_SUMMARY.semantics: enables a forced final-summary model call after a guard stop.

RAKAZO_GUARD_SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_MS.semantics: integer milliseconds for the guard-summary call.

STREAMRETRY_ENABLED.source: pi-runtime.ts streamRetryEnabled: off when trim.toLowerCase() is 0/false/off/no; unset defaults on
STREAMRETRY_ENABLED.semantics: kill switch for one retry of a dropped stream before any tool call.
